name: TNFR1 signaling and its restraint of apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: All members concern TNFR1 signaling outputs (proapoptotic, NF-kB, linear ubiquitination) and their negative regulation; unlike the NF-kB-activation confusables, this theme carries the negative regulation of death-receptor apoptosis and necrotic death.

name: Dental mineralization and phosphate-linked ectopic calcification
rationale: Members cover enamel/dentin formation, tooth eruption, phosphate transport, secreted-protein phosphorylation and calcification disorders (PXE, IBGC1); confusables are about bicarbonate/anion transport or renal phosphate homeostasis and lack the tooth members.

name: Nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron morphogenesis
rationale: All members are metanephric/mesonephric kidney morphogenesis; the mesonephric duct, ureteric bud and ureter members distinguish it from confusables focused on tubule segment patterning and renal vesicle formation.

name: Alkylation damage reversal and base excision gap-filling repair
rationale: Members are direct alkylation reversal (MGMT, ALKBH2/3) plus long-patch and single-nucleotide base excision repair gap-filling; confusables have TET/TDG demethylation or glycosylase recognition steps instead.

name: Fibronectin-integrin adhesion and Rho-driven stress fiber assembly
rationale: Members span integrin/syndecan-fibronectin adhesion, ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesions and Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fiber remodeling; confusables lack the fibronectin matrix, ILK complex and Rho effectors, centering on SRF targets or MET-driven spreading.

qualifier: interferon-alpha signature with OAS and IP-10
name: Interferon-alpha antiviral signature with OAS and IP-10 induction
rationale: All members are type I interferon/antiviral responses and IFN-stimulated gene signatures; the OAS, IP-10, IFN-alpha response and cytosolic DNA sensing members separate it from confusables built on ISG15, IFN-signaling feedback or RIG-I/dsRNA sensing.

name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate hydrogen peroxide-, oxidative stress- and hypoxia/oxygen-glucose deprivation-triggered intrinsic apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization; confusables instead regulate respiration/OXPHOS, ferroptosis or MOMP/cytochrome c release.

name: Iron uptake, heme scavenging and erythrocyte gas exchange
rationale: Members cover transferrin/ferroportin/DMT1/ceruloplasmin iron handling, heme transport and scavenging, and erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport; confusables add heme biosynthesis and Rh ammonium transport, cadmium handling or pathogen iron assimilation instead.

qualifier: mtDNA replication through translation, with tRNA processing
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, translation and tRNA processing
rationale: Nearly all members are steps of mitochondrial genome maintenance and expression (mtDNA replication/repair, transcription, RNA processing/decay, mitoribosome assembly, translation) plus tRNA end processing; confusables are dominated by tRNA/rRNA modification chemistry and aminoacylation.

name: HDAC and CHD-remodeler chromatin silencing of retroelements
rationale: Most members are repressive chromatin machinery (HDACs, NuRD/CHD, ChAHP, MECP2-NCoR, SUMOylated corepressors) silencing retroelements (KRAB-ZFP, HUSH) and the inactive X; confusables are broader histone methylation/acetylation and BAF assembly; 'organism emergence' is an outlier.

name: IRF3-driven interferon-beta induction and its cGAS-STING restraint
rationale: Members are IRF3-mediated type I IFN induction, interferon-beta response and production control, and negative regulation of cGAS/STING; confusables center on RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TBK1 regulation or IFN-alpha/OAS responses.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar synthesis and SLC35 transport, N-glycan trimming
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and transport for N-glycan processing
rationale: Members synthesize UDP-sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose, UDP-glucuronate, Dol-P-Glc), transport them into the Golgi (SLC35A1-3) and process/trim N-glycans (MOGS, MAN1B1); confusables center on GPI anchors, dolichol/mannose CDGs, sialic acid or O-glycan/fucose synthesis.

name: Coronavirus replicase translation, frameshifting and host translation control
rationale: Members cover coronavirus replicase translation and maturation, ribosomal frameshifting, translational elongation control and SARS modulation of host translation; confusables cover genome replication, capping, IFIT evasion or influenza RNP synthesis.

core: Golgi lipid transfer and protein lipidation
name: ER-Golgi lipid transfer, RAB prenylation and Wnt secretion
rationale: Members combine phosphatidylinositol synthesis and ER-Golgi lipid transfer, RAB geranylgeranylation/activation, and PORCN-dependent Wnt and lysosomal enzyme secretion; confusables lack the Wnt secretion and RAB members, centering on glycolipid transport, RAS processing or general vesicle traffic.

name: Cobalamin intestinal uptake and systemic transport
rationale: All members concern absorbing and carrying vitamin B12 (intrinsic factor, cubilin/amnionless, transcobalamin, ABCD4, cobalt transport); confusables cover intracellular cobalamin metabolism and other vitamin transport.

name: Retrograde protein export from ER to cytosol
rationale: All members concern proteins leaving the ER toward the cytosol (retrotranslocation and its regulation); confusables cover downstream ERAD/quality control, SRP-dependent ER import or COPI/COPII vesicle traffic.

name: Ubiquitin chain editing by USP and OTU deubiquitinases
rationale: Members are deubiquitination of K48/K11 chains by USP and OTU proteases, its positive regulation and restraint of K63 ubiquitination, plus ubiquitin activation; confusables cover NF-kB/SUMO regulation, chain-type ubiquitination by E3s, or UCH/metalloprotease DUBs.

qualifier: cobalamin absorption with thiamine and riboflavin
name: Cobalamin absorption plus thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover dietary B12 uptake and delivery (intrinsic factor, cubilin/amnionless, transcobalamin) together with thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism; confusables are intracellular cobalamin metabolism or vitamin E/ubiquinone and lack the B1/B2 members.

name: Protein methylation, hydroxylation and translation factor modifications
rationale: Members are covalent residue modifications: lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation, lysine/proline hydroxylation, and translation-apparatus modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine); the methylation members separate it from confusables on translation initiation/termination, selenocysteine or polyamines.

name: Mesenchymal progenitor TGF-beta signaling and cadherin gene regulation
rationale: Members combine TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signaling in mesenchymal stem cells with transcriptional control of CDH1, CDH11, CDH19 and FGFR2 splicing; confusables center on osteoblast differentiation and bone formation or generic transcriptional repression.

name: Apical membrane targeting and CFTR-dependent epithelial water transport
rationale: Members cover apical surface/raft protein localization and CFTR trafficking, cystic fibrosis and transepithelial water transport; confusables center on TRP/K+ channels and pancreatic secretion, basolateral secretion, or canalicular phospholipid/bile transport.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling and clearance with cholesterol homeostasis
name: Lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cellular cholesterol homeostasis
rationale: Members span chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and receptor-mediated clearance, ABC-transporter efflux and SREBP/LXR control of cellular cholesterol; confusables are vitamin E transport or bile acid synthesis and signaling.

name: Synapse assembly with glutamate and GABA receptor clustering
rationale: Members build pre- and postsynaptic membranes and cluster NMDA, GABA-A, PSD-95 and gephyrin while tuning excitatory/inhibitory potentials; confusables center on synaptic adhesion molecules and receptor tyrosine phosphatases.

name: RNA polymerase II pausing, elongation and termination control
rationale: Most members regulate Pol II promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination (two translation-elongation/frameshifting members are outliers); confusables add Pol I/III, HIV transcription, rRNA processing or splicing.

name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress responses with oxidative apoptosis control
rationale: Members are cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen, hydrogen sulfide and ischemia plus regulation of oxidative stress-induced apoptosis; the nitrosative/ischemic members separate it from confusables on hyperoxia/UPRmt, ferroptosis or respiration control.
